body:
Width

Any vehicle exceeding 3.2(10' 6")

  • > Lights at night, lights and/or flags during the day on all extremities.
  • >Over dimensions sign on the front and the rear of load vehicles
  • >Preceded by one escort vehicle (does not apply to vehicles hauling between Alberta N.W.T. border and Hay River)
  • >Display one or two rotating amber light(s) on top of the truck tractor cab. (this ONLY applies to vechiles hauling between the Alberta/N.W.T. and Hay River.

Any vehicle exceeding 3.85(12' 7")

  • >Lights at night, lights and/or flags during the dayon all extremities.
  • >Over dimension sign on the front and the rear of the load vehicle(s)
  • >Display one or two rotatating amber light(s) on the top of the truck tractor cab.
  • > Preceded by one escort/pilot vehicle.

Any vehicle exceeding 4.45m (14' 7")

  • >Light at night, lights and/or flags during day on all extremities.
  • >Over-dimension sign on front and rear of load vehicle(s)
  • >Display one or two rotating amber light(s) on top of the truck tractor cab.
  • > Preceded by one escort/pilot vehicle.
  • >Followed by another escort vehicle.

Length

  • Straight truck trailer combination exceeding 21 m (68'10")
  • > Permit required.
  • Truck tractor semi-trailer combination exceeding 25 m (82')
  • > Permit required.

Pole truck, maximum length 26 m (85' 3")

  • Any vehicle exceeding 29 m (95' 1").
  • >Followed by one escort/pilot vehicle
  • >Permit required.

Height

Any vehicle exceeding 4.2 m (13' 9")

  • > Permit required

Front Projection

  • Projection exceeding, 3 m (9' 10" ) from Steering axle.
  • > Lights at night, light and/or flags during the day on the projection.
  • > Permit required

Rear Projection

  • Projection exceeding 1.5 m (4' 11") from rear of vehicle.
  • > Lights at night, lights and/or flags during the day on the projection.
  • >Can NOT exceed effective overhang.
  • >NO permit required

Side Projection

  • Any load exceeding 15 cm (6") from the side of the vehicle.
  • > Lights at night, lights and/or flags during the day on the projection.
  • > NO permit required.
